story_type: fishing boat on fire, five abandon ship into a life raft, good Samaritan boat picks them up
hook: Their boat caught fire 16 miles out. Five people, one raft.
narration: Their seventy four foot fishing boat was on fire, sixteen miles out in the Gulf of Mexico.
All five people aboard abandoned ship into a life raft.
Behind them, the boat kept burning.
[short pause] A Coast Guard Jayhawk from Air Station Clearwater came overhead and lowered a rescue swimmer to check on them.
Life raft canopies are bright for a reason. From the air, that color stands out on open water.
A good Samaritan aboard a fishing boat named Double D pulled up beside the raft.
He took all five of them aboard.
outcome: All five came through uninjured and were taken to Suwannee Marina.

location_card.place: 16 miles west of Crystal River, Florida

title: Fishing boat burned, 5 took to a raft
description:
On April 1, 2017, five people abandoned ship after their 74-foot fishing boat caught fire 16 miles west of Crystal River, Florida. A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater rescue swimmer checked on them, and a good Samaritan aboard the fishing boat Double D recovered all five from their life raft.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, courtesy U.S. Coast Guard PADET Tampa Bay, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/517049/coast-guard-assists-5-people-who-abandon-ship-16-miles-west-crystal-river-fla
